name: hud_ui_bar_set_point_xy
description: HudUiBar::SetPointXY stores an in-range bar point, grows the active vertex count, moves the element when point zero is changed, and invalidates after every call.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD bar/meter tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bcf80 validates accepting point indices 0 through 20, storing x/y at points[index], growing drawVertexCount to index+1 when needed, calling the SetPos ftable slot with _ftol-converted x/y only for point index 0, and calling the Invalidate ftable slot even for out-of-range indices.

The native smoke verifies point zero storage, SetPos truncation and invalidation, later-point storage and vertex-count growth without SetPos, and negative/out-of-range indices preserving point state while still invalidating.
